_meta.principle: Optical capture ONLY: focal length + aperture + lens character + DoF. Lens choice determines compression, perspective, and out-of-focus quality. Ownership boundary: lens does NOT describe spatial layering (depth.json) or subject placement (composition.json).
sources: Higgsfield AI tutorial transcript 2026-05-03 (texture and capture mentioned)
Cinematography Mailing List archives — focal-length perspective primer
_meta.interpolation_rule: Paste fragment verbatim into the lens clause.

DD.seeded_from: CLAUDE.md DD: premium product compressed depth, classic portrait

HR.seeded_from: CLAUDE.md HR: dictation device + environment, UI-friendly framing

35mm_f2_environmental.name: 35mm f/2 environmental
35mm_f2_environmental.use: Default human-environmental shot. Slight wide-of-normal, mild perspective expansion, shallow but not extreme DoF. The journalism / documentary default.
35mm_f2_environmental.fragment: shot on a 35mm prime at roughly f/2 aperture, slightly wider than normal perspective, mild background separation with environmental context still readable, the natural-eye documentary look

50mm_f1.8_natural_eye.name: 50mm f/1.8 natural eye
50mm_f1.8_natural_eye.use: The 'normal' lens. Mimics human eye perspective. Default for portraits with environmental context. Shallow but not creamy DoF.
50mm_f1.8_natural_eye.fragment: shot on a 50mm prime at f/1.8, perspective matching the natural human eye, gentle background blur, the classic standard-prime portrait look

85mm_f1.4_portrait_compressed.name: 85mm f/1.4 portrait compressed
85mm_f1.4_portrait_compressed.use: Classic portrait lens. Compresses background, creamy bokeh, flattering on faces. Subject pops out of frame.
85mm_f1.4_portrait_compressed.fragment: shot on an 85mm prime at f/1.4 wide open, compressed perspective flattering to faces, creamy out-of-focus background bokeh, subject visually carved from a softened backdrop

24mm_f4_wide_deep.name: 24mm f/4 wide deep-focus
24mm_f4_wide_deep.use: Wide environmental shot. Most of the frame in focus. Used for establishing shots, architecture, group scenes.
24mm_f4_wide_deep.fragment: shot on a 24mm wide-angle at f/4 stopped down, expansive field of view with mild edge stretching, deep front-to-back focus across the frame

100mm_macro_extreme_close.name: 100mm macro extreme close
100mm_macro_extreme_close.use: Product detail, food, jewelry, textures. Razor-thin DoF, close working distance.
100mm_macro_extreme_close.fragment: shot on a 100mm macro lens at close focusing distance, razor-thin depth of field with most of the frame falling into soft focus, fine detail in the focal plane crisp and resolving

anamorphic_widescreen.name: Anamorphic widescreen 2.39:1
anamorphic_widescreen.use: Cinematic widescreen feel. Horizontal lens flares, oval bokeh, slight squeeze. For images that should feel like a film still.
anamorphic_widescreen.fragment: anamorphic lens character at roughly 2.39:1 cinematic widescreen aspect, oval-shaped out-of-focus highlights, horizontal lens flares if light sources are present, slight horizontal squeeze
anamorphic_widescreen.warning: Cinematic flag. Avoid for vertical 9:16 formats — the horizontal character fights the frame.

phone_camera_18mm.name: Phone camera 18mm equivalent
phone_camera_18mm.use: iPhone/Android shot look. Wide, deep DoF, slight HDR-flat tone. Used for UGC and authentic-feeling content.
phone_camera_18mm.fragment: shot on a phone camera at roughly 18mm-equivalent wide angle, deep depth of field with most of the frame in focus, slight HDR-flat tonal compression, the casual phone-photography look

vintage_swirly_bokeh.name: Vintage swirly bokeh
vintage_swirly_bokeh.use: Helios-44 / Petzval feel. Background bokeh swirls in a circular pattern around the subject. Painterly, dreamy, vintage.
vintage_swirly_bokeh.fragment: shot on a vintage Petzval-style lens, background bokeh swirling in a circular pattern around the subject, soft painterly out-of-focus areas, the dreamy distinctive look of vintage Soviet-era optics

tilt_shift_miniature.name: Tilt-shift miniature
tilt_shift_miniature.use: Selective focus band creating miniature illusion. Top-down or wide aerial scenes look like dioramas.
tilt_shift_miniature.fragment: tilt-shift lens effect with a narrow horizontal band in sharp focus and the top and bottom of the frame thrown into soft blur, creating the optical illusion of a miniature diorama

fisheye_distorted.name: Fisheye distorted
fisheye_distorted.use: Extreme wide with curvilinear distortion. Skateboarding, GoPro, surreal. Strong visual signature.
fisheye_distorted.fragment: fisheye lens with extreme curvilinear distortion bending straight lines into curves at the edges, ultra-wide field of view, the surreal extreme-perspective signature
fisheye_distorted.warning: Strong signature. Use only when the distortion serves the message.
